title: A Talent Show
subtitle: 考点：能力 / 乐器 / 一般现在时
passage: Our club has a talent show today. Tom plays the drums. His rhythm is great. Lily plays the violin. She can even play a long song without the music book.
Amy paints a picture on the stage. Everyone is surprised at their abilities. Mr. Hu says, "Everyone has some ability. Find yours!"
vocab: ability 能力 · drum 鼓 · violin 小提琴 · paint 用颜料画 · even 甚至 · musical instrument 乐器

options: Play a long song without the book.
questions.why: She can even play a long song without the music book.

questions.stem: What does Amy do on the stage?
questions.why: Amy paints a picture on the stage.
Everyone has some ability. Find yours!
